newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: EU grants Zambia $200 million over next five years.
newsitem.headline: EU grants Zambia $200 million over next five years.

text.p: The European Commission will give Zambia 183 million ecu ($200 million) over the next five years, of which more than half will be spent on water and transportation sectors, Finance Minister Ronald Penza said.
Announcing the grant on Thursday he said 54 percent of the funds would be spent on the development of the private sector and upgrading the country's roads and water supply.
Some 24 percent would be channelled into education and training and health reform.

Fifteen percent would be used for balance of payment support and to strengthen the ministry of finance, central bank and other government economic functions. The rest of the funds would be spent on a drug enforcement agency and cultural facilities.
